verdict.rationale: Kling's own homepage advertises an MCP/CLI offering that lets an external agent drive Kling, which indicates a first-party MCP integration. The evidence is only a single marketing headline. It gives no setup instructions, transport or endpoint details, tool list, or authentication flow. Missing for 10: MCP server documentation (install/connect steps, exposed tools, auth), confirmation it is an official server rather than only a CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: MCP / CLI Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale
